architecture.runtime: static site (GitHub Pages), ES modules with an import map, no build step; Node ≥ 20 for tests, Python 3 for data builds

modules.js/app.js: orchestration: row scopes, focus modes, panels, map layers, building camera, URL state
modules.js/model.js: decode data/schools.json; measures (students | count | learning, countsRecords), groups, levels, sizes, pin sizes, importance, filters, summaries
modules.js/areas.js: district index, frames, per-district totals (students, records, unknown students)
modules.js/area-insight.js: the first Aha (home province, top districts, rail comparison, outside finding)
modules.js/profile-model.js: overview, district, station, affiliation, building and school models; comparison set; enrolment history; the learning models (overview, district, station, building, record) and the learning context of the school views
modules.js/learning.js: decode data/learning.json (0.2.0): learning rows with the shared row interface, services, point states, filters (search · province · service), service mix, nearPoint, learningContext
modules.js/panel.js: reading panel views as HTML strings (provenance line, no caveat); learning views and the learning sections of the school views
modules.js/charts.js: district bars, district × group matrix, affiliation bars; under the learning measure district × service and service bars
modules.js/map-layers.js: district choropleth (li.supply | count — records and learning records, 41 samples), labels
modules.js/frames.js: district outlines per province on demand
modules.js/scales.js: LDS count and LI li.supply ramps (41 samples by rank)
modules.js/cues.js: school group → LDS series + shape cue
modules.js/pins.js: one symbol per row with a point, area ∝ students (a learning record at the 200-student size, js/pins.js#sizeValue); HTML pins from zoom 15.5
modules.js/stations.js: CityMETER · Transit stations and the 500 m radius
modules.js/ask.js: Google AI / Maps / Street View actions per view
modules.js/breadcrumb.js: ประเทศไทย › จังหวัด › เขต/อำเภอ with production deep links (?d=school)
modules.js/shell/building-join.js: display-time point-in-footprint join; nearest drawn building for the camera
modules.js/massing.js: city and focus massing tiers; CityMETER Building V4 inside CityMETER units (shapeCmTile, planCmRequests), OSM parts override, context layer, credit
modules.js/shell/camera.js: presets, pitched fits and the building camera (terrain-aware: groundAt, projectAltitude)
modules.js/shell/venue-xray.js: the building being looked at drawn over every other building
modules.js/shell/mvt.js: vector tile decoding for the focus tier
modules.js/navigation.js: nav-7 and pictogram font contracts, help dialog
modules.js/shell/launch.js: classic launch script (loading, errors, file:// bridge to the public site)
modules.js/labels.js: names near the middle of the view (importance = students + published tuition percentiles), short names, hover card of icon chips
modules.js/shell/terrain.js: terrain mode at hilly sites and round a building or school; the terrain facts of a school
modules.js/shell/building-units.js: buildings per area: the per-province unit files (data/building-units/), CityMETER zones, production tile URLs and the attribution

rowScopes.scopeRows: rows after search · group · level · size · province · affiliation, before any district selection or focus: the comparison base of the Aha, the choropleth, the charts and every rank
rowScopes.baseRows: scopeRows narrowed by the selected เขต/อำเภอ
rowScopes.rows: baseRows narrowed by the district focus: pins with detail, counters, the table
rowScopes.learning: under the learning measure the scopes hold the learning rows (search · province · service; the school fields are hidden and cleared)
